export BASHLPR_SPOOL="$HOME/spool" BASHLPR_BACKEND="$HOME/backend" BASHLPR_TIMEOUT=0
export LPR_FIXTURE_MODE=cancel
"$HOME/backend" --witness > "$HOME/witness.out" 2> "$HOME/witness.err" & witness=$!
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [[ -s $HOME/witness.ready ]] && break; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done
[[ -s $HOME/witness.ready ]] && echo witness=ready || echo witness=BAD
( lpr submit 'data/file with space' > "$HOME/cancel.out" 2> "$HOME/cancel.err"; printf '%s\n' "$?" > "$HOME/submit.status" ) &
owner=$!
for ((i=0;i<120;i++)); do [[ -s $HOME/cancel.ready ]] && break; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done
if [[ -s $HOME/cancel.ready ]]; then
 read -r id < "$HOME/cancel.ready"
 [[ $id =~ ^[0-9a-f]{16}$ && -p $BASHLPR_SPOOL/$id.ctl && -f $BASHLPR_SPOOL/$id.lpr ]] && echo ready=fifo-and-spool || echo ready=BAD

 [[ $list_rc == 0 && $(< "$HOME/list.out") == "$id active 28" ]] && echo list=active || echo list=BAD
 lpr cancel "$id" > "$HOME/cancel-command.out" 2> "$HOME/cancel-command.err"; printf 'cancel=%s\n' "$?"

 echo ready=BAD; echo list=BAD; echo cancel=missing
fi
